# std/lt

> < : less than

truck [std](../std.md) · [source](../../../registry/std/lt.pkg) · translated by [bintables/lt](../bintables/lt.md)

Less than: 1 or 0 (signed comparison).

```
print 2 < 3     // 1
```

Infix, precedence 40, left-associative. Both operands must be `int`; the
result is `int`.

## Syntax

Kind: `infix`, precedence 40, left-associative
